title: Replace this with your one-line hook
subtitle: The sentence that makes someone lean in. Specific beats clever.

headline: Name the pain: make it felt, not abstract
body: Describe the moment it goes wrong, the way the person living it would describe it.
If they nod before you finish the sentence, you've got the right problem.

headline: Before and after, side by side

left.headline: Today
left.body: How it works now: the friction, the workaround, the thing everyone quietly tolerates.

right.headline: With this
right.body: The same moment, but easier. Keep it concrete. One vivid 'after' beats five features.

pillars.title: Step one
pillars.text: The first thing that happens. Plain words.

pillars.title: Step two
pillars.text: Where the magic is. Say it like you'd say it to a friend.

pillars.title: Step three
pillars.text: The payoff. What they walk away with.

quote: End on the sentence you want them to repeat to someone else.

title: Here's what I want from you
subtitle: One clear next step. Your name, your link, the thing to do now.
